institution: Central Institute of Indian Languages, Bhasha Sanchika / Bharatavani Catalogue
title: मुण्डारी-व्याकरण (Mundari-Vyakaran)
author: Ramdayal Munda
blocker: The first-party bitstream endpoint renders a one-page PDF cover in the web inspection path, but independent binary materialization failed in the execution environment. Byte hash, full pagination, textual contents, reuse terms beyond rights-holder metadata, community validation and cultural-access authorization therefore remain unresolved.
release_effect: Exact locator and first-party metadata strengthened; no evidence-graph count change and no linguistic/cultural factual claim promotion.
